title: kanban ledger issue.yaml (format 3)
description: A kanban/issues/<id>/issue.yaml, format version 3. Derived from docs/ledger.md; where they differ, ledger.md is right. The folder's name is the issue's id. Any other key is allowed and kept. status is one of config.yaml columns, which a schema of one file can't check.

id.description: Same as the folder name. One plain name: no /, \ or :, and not . or ...

title.description: Required to be a useful issue; an issue without one is listed with no title.

status.description: One of config.yaml columns (by default todo, queued, doing, review, done). A value not in columns is shown in the first column.

repo.description: One of config.yaml repos: the repository the issue works in.

parent.description: Id of the issue this is part of (an epic).

after.description: Ids in this ledger that must be done first.

profile.description: The yard's profile for the agent (opus, codex, reviewer, ...). The yard defines profiles; the ledger only keeps the name.

who.description: person: a person's issue (a decision to make, or work only a person can do). Absent: an agent's issue.

agent.description: The terminal working on it: its herdr-core address on the ledger's own machine (t3, not vps/t3). A tab or terminal name is also accepted by readers.

session.description: The id of the agent's harness session (a UUID, lowercase), so the yard can resume it after its terminal is lost. The yard writes it; the ledger only keeps it.

links.description: http(s) URLs, or paths relative to the root.

routine.description: The name of the routine that added it (routines/<name>.yaml). One plain name: no /, \ or :, and not . or ...

not_before.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD: kanban ready does not list the issue before that day (read in config.yaml timezone, else UTC). Whatever the status; after still holds it back as well.

created.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, written as a string.

updated.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, written as a string.
